design.scope: 5504 fresh Haiku-only episodes under the same task policy and generator, with a new seed and forced tool response format (512 tokens). No earlier responses are reused or pooled. Format control differs from the original matched study and is not a model-ranking intervention. No critic, no memory, no selection by observed effect. Equal eight-family weights. A new independent US$2 cap makes all new experiment allowances total at most US$8 (refund 4.8, travel/live 1.2, scale 2). Earlier counters remain intact. Unavailable results are never retried or assigned a fabricated proposal loss. This campaign cannot support an unmatched Sonnet comparison.

conditional_loss_bound.assumption: Adapted bounded outcomes; cap and rho fixed before observation; all completed episodes included

analysis.formula: P(L > t) = sum_s w_s P(L > t | scenario s)
analysis.scope: Large Haiku-only campaign: eight equal-weight synthetic travel families, no critic or memory. All 5,504 cases are fresh. Forced propose_booking output with a 512-token limit differs from the original matched study; no old responses are reused or pooled. Sonnet and critic comparisons use only the separate matched 32-case study. Tail intervals are marginal Jeffreys-posterior intervals, not simultaneous Bayesian guarantees. A separate 5% frequentist family covers 32 exact tail cells for a complete fixed batch, under within-family IID fixed-policy assumptions; a separate 5% dollar sequence gives union coverage at least 90% for those two families. Financial posteriors condition on resolved outcomes. Unavailable financial outcomes retain uncertainty. An additional exact bound targets the fully observed adverse-or-unresolved indicator, counting a missing proposal as an operational adverse event; it does not assign an invented financial loss. Missing-loss sensitivity spans $0–$1,000 for each unresolved episode. Example selection is illustrative; every processed case enters the estimates.

example_rule: First resolved harmful and first resolved harmless case per family in frozen case order. Examples are not a representative subsample; every processed result enters the aggregate.
